item.title: Power Shutdown by KPDCL
item.description: SRINAGAR: Chief Engineer, Distribution KPDCL has informed that Shutdown of 33 KV Chanapora and Baghimehtab line will be observed due to which power supply to Naik Bagh, Natipora, Baghat, Sanat Nagar, Chanapora, Baghimehtab, Kralpora, Mochwa and adjoining areas will be affected from 09:30 AM to 03 PM on 29 January 2026.
